heading: Shore patrol duty; payment of expenses
lead: An officer or cadet of the Coast Guard who is assigned shore patrol duty away from his vessel or other duty station may be paid his actual expenses.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2018—Pub. L. 115–282 renumbered section 510 of this title as this section.
